answer: The beacon schedule is applied in willow and timber exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1967 identities would post 4839 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
